rows.07:29a50:
Hino was grinning with delight.
"The finishing blow, at least, is mine. Call it punishment, the least you deserve for robbing me of my fun."
"P-punishment...?"
I forced my voice out desperately.
"That's right. Why do you think I let the people I liked into the Murder Club?"{p}
rows.08:96d8:
Is that a bit too convenient an interpretation?
I know it is, but I can't help thinking so.{p}
rows.10:3f28:
Aizawa stuffed the guinea pig into a burlap sack he had prepared in advance and carried it on his back to the school.
Then he snuck into the school at night and silently made his way up to the roof.
Of course, the door was locked.
He broke the lock with pliers and a hammer, and the wind came gusting in; he met it head-on with his whole body.{p}

notes: 07:29a50: FIX - 'a little punishment' shrank seme-te mo no batsu (the least/minimum punishment) into a small one; restored 'the least you deserve', kept the editor's 'punishment' echo.
08:96d8: FIX - ee (yes, conceding) had become hedged 'Perhaps it is'; now 'I know it is, but...', which keeps the concession without adding doubt.

10:3f28: FIX - zenshin de uketomemashita: he takes the wind on his whole body (sets up his king-of-the-world mood in 10:4154); 'struck him full force' made him passive. Now 'he met it head-on with his whole body'.
